lead.en: Textbook exercises arranged by section, one section per page, with step-by-step solutions. Marks and (1M)/(1A) step marks are set by the teacher for checking your working.

title.zh: 第 17 章 排列與組合

intro.zh: 第 17 章分三節：17.1 計數基本原理、17.2 排列、17.3 組合。三節的課本練習都已提供逐步題解：先學「分類用加、分步用乘」，再學排列（有次序），最後學組合（不計次序）。
intro.en: Chapter 17 has three sections: 17.1 basic counting principles, 17.2 permutations and 17.3 combinations. All three sections now have step-by-step solutions: first add for cases and multiply for steps, then permutations (order matters) and finally combinations (order ignored).

title.zh: 第 18 章 概率的進一步認識

intro.zh: 第 18 章分四節：18.1 集合、18.2 概率的加法定律、18.3 概率的乘法、18.4 概率與計數。18.1 與 18.2 的課本練習（Exercise 18.1、Exercise 18.2）已上線，18.3、18.4 整理好會陸續加入；各節標題以課本為準，有需要會再校正。
intro.en: Chapter 18 has four sections: 18.1 sets, 18.2 the addition law of probability, 18.3 multiplication of probabilities and 18.4 probability by counting. The 18.1 and 18.2 book exercises are online; 18.3 and 18.4 will follow. Section titles follow the textbook and may be adjusted later.

comingSoon.zh: 之後會陸續加入其他章節測驗、課本練習與考試檢討 —— 資料放在 data/src/，加一個檔案就可以。第 17 章三節已全部上線；第 18 章已上 18.1 與 18.2，18.3、18.4 整理中。
comingSoon.en: More chapter tests, classwork and exam reviews will be added; each part is a single file in data/src/. All three sections of Chapter 17 are online, and Chapter 18 now has 18.1 and 18.2 while 18.3 and 18.4 are being prepared.
